name: Extinction
description:
Slain entities are marked for _extinction_, permanently granting 1 stack. Strikes deal +0.25 hearts damage per stack against that entity type, up to +5-10 ❤. 
- 	Bosses grant 4 stacks and, at max level, the bonus damage to them is uncapped. Stacks have no effect in Trials.

Only one entity type can be marked at a time. A new type can be marked by gaining 5 _extinction_ stacks against it.
